senses.gloss: गाढ गाढ. See under rt. गाह्.

गाढ, अस्, आ, अम्, dived into, bathed in, entered
into; deeply entered, closely pressed together, tightly
drawn, closely fastened, close, fast (opposed to शि-
थिल); thick, dense; deep (as sleep); strong, vehe-
ment, firm; (अम्), ind. excessively, much, very
much, heavily, closely, firmly, strongly, &c.
—गाढ-
कर्ण, अस्, m. an ear penetrated by sound, an attentive
[]
ear.
—गाढ-ता, f. or गाढ-त्व, अम्, n. intensity,
closeness; firmness, hardness; excess.
—गाढ-
मुष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, close-fisted, avaricious, niggardly,
miserly; (इस्), m. a scymitar, a large sacrificial knife.
—गाढ-शोक-प्रहार, अस्, आ, अम्, inflicting the
keenest anguish.
—गाढाङ्गद (˚ढ-अङ्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, having closely fitting bracelets.
—गाढा-
लिङ्गन (˚ढ-आल्˚), अम्, n. a close embrace.
